crossRefs.note: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just…
In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of…
After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the…
You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely…
In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our…
For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches…
The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.” ’ ”

people.name: Gog
people.line: A symbolic enemy of God's people in prophetic literature.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?
translations.bsb: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and tell Gog that this is what the Lord GOD says: On that day when My people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not take notice of this?
translations.kjv: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know
translations.asv: Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In that day when my people Israel dwelleth securely, shalt thou not know it?
